title: Composite-level aggregation in rotation curve model selection: A sign-flip decomposition of ∆AIC for SPARC-175
abstract: Re-fits the SPARC-175 rotation-curve sample with the Kill-Test v6 pipeline and decomposes each galaxy’s ∆AIC into inner (r < rc) and outer (r ≥ rc) contributions to test whether single-number ∆AIC masks regime-dependent behavior. Finds a robust sign-flip phenomenon in 17.5% of galaxies at rc = 3 kpc (16.4–22.2% across rc ∈ {2,3,4,5} kpc) and shows that removing χ2-weighting moves the sample further toward EFC, indicating the issue is aggregation-level, not a weighting bias.
